name: full_bench_short_summaries
description: A collection of short textual summaries intended to support retrieval-augmented workflows for math benchmarks (part of the RAG4Math project). It provides condensed descriptions/metadata of math problems and benchmarks to be used as retrieval documents or prompts for downstream math reasoning. The resource is primarily aimed at improving retrieval relevance and grounding for math problem solving.
evaluation_method: recall@k (retrieval relevance), optionally downstream task accuracy
reputation: Part of the RAG4Math project and used in retrieval-augmented math research; niche but useful within that research community.
